FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sound & Vision Solutions, we specialize in retail sales of new audio and visual equipment, including televisions, amplifiers, and microphones, all sourced from reputable manufacturers to ensure top-quality products. Our services extend to the rental of various A/V equipment for events, such as speakers, mixers, lighting, and projectors, with rigorous maintenance and testing protocols in place to minimize the risk of equipment malfunction. We operate from a secure retail storefront, which allows us to maintain an effective inventory management system, enhancing our loss prevention efforts. Our team consists of certified technicians who provide installation and repair services, ensuring that all work meets professional standards. We have been serving our community for over three years, developing a strong reputation built on reliability and excellence in customer service. Through both physical and online sales channels, we offer secure payment options and verified shipping methods, driving our mission to be a trusted provider in the audio and visual equipment industry.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sound & Vision Productions, LLC - Specializing in A/V equipment rental for events, offering robust inventory management and compliance with safety protocols.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a high-quality projector was damaged during transportation to a corporate event due to improper securing in the delivery vehicle. The estimated loss amount is $1,500. The claim has been submitted and is currently under review with the insurance company. Additionally, on April 15, 2023, a microphone was stolen while left unattended during an outdoor event setup, resulting in a loss of $1,000. This claim has been processed and paid in full.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $500 deductible.
